name: Fiana Clewing
original_name: フィアナ・クレヴィング
source:
Princess of the country of Solide. She is in a position to temporarily rule the country on behalf of her detained father.
While she is proud of her father as a king who won the war and developed the country, he accepts it as a teacher when it comes to taking forcible measures for the prosperity of the nation.
She tries to act as a dignified knight, and her sword skills, which she has been training since she was a child, is one of the best in the country.
